name: Pin☆Star ~Zecchou Kaiden 3 Shimai~
original_name: ぴん☆すた～絶頂皆伝3姉妹～
source:
"Sextreme" is kind of a sports competition that is to attract audience by dancing sex. This is still underground but taken place all over the world. Mamika finds Saizo's sextreme talent and he sweeps over Sextreme competitions in USA. He comes to back to Japan. Saizo's goal is to be the third successor to Sextreme. Saizo looks for his sextreme partner to win the competition in Japan...

translation:
“Sextreme”是一种通过性爱舞蹈来吸引观众的体育比赛。这仍然是在地下，但发生在世界各地。Mamika发现了Saizo的Sextreme天赋，他横扫了美国的Sextreme比赛。他回到日本。Saizo的目标是成为Sextreme的第三任继承者。Saizo寻找他的性爱搭档来赢得日本的比赛……
